tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: As per tender notification all documents-Agency Registration Certificate, PAN Card Copy, GST Registration Certificate along with copies of last one year GST Returns or Certificate of Exemption from GST Registration, Copies of Income Tax Returns, Certified copy of Registration Certificate / Official RC Extract issued by the RTO, Vehicle Fitness Certificate, Insurance Policy copy, Vehicle Tax payment receipt / Tax clearance details, Valid Contract Carriage Permit Form 42, Emission Test Certificate, Clear recent color photographs of the vehicle, Driving License / DL Extract of the designated driver, Past Service Records / Experience Certificate in similar vehicle hire services to Government / PSUs / Corporate bodies
